transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

For the past nine months, I've had this massive surge of energy and barely need any sleep, but I still feel completely wired. My mood has been all over the place, switching between feeling incredibly high and happy to getting extremely irritated over the smallest things. I just can't seem to slow down or find a balance.
During those high-energy periods, have you ever experienced symptoms so severe that you required hospitalization or were unable to function in your daily life, such as at work or home?

No, I haven't been hospitalized, but my daily life and work have become incredibly chaotic and difficult to manage. I'm constantly getting distracted and switching between different tasks, so nothing actually gets finished.

Have you struggled with these difficulties regarding distraction, difficulty finishing tasks, and restlessness since you were a child, or is this a relatively new pattern that only started in the last nine months?

No, I never struggled with these things when I was a child. This is a completely new pattern that only started about nine months ago. Before that, I was always able to focus and finish my tasks without any issues.
During these past nine months, have there been any periods where your mood dropped significantly, leaving you feeling hopeless, losing interest in things you usually enjoy, or having very low energy?
No, I haven't experienced any of those low moods or felt hopeless at all during this time. My energy has stayed completely high, and I haven't felt depressed or lost interest in anything.
During these periods of high energy, have you ever heard voices, seen things that others couldn't, or felt like you had special powers or beliefs that others didn't share?

Yes, when my energy is incredibly high, I've heard voices and seen things that aren't actually there, and I truly believed I had special, extraordinary powers and a grand purpose. These unusual experiences and beliefs only happen during these intense, high-energy phases and never when my mood is normal.
